# `chrome-cdp close`

Close the session: its daemon, and the browser it launched

```text
chrome-cdp close [OPTIONS]
```

Options:

- `--all`: Close every running session

```text
Examples:
  chrome-cdp close
  chrome-cdp close --session shop
  chrome-cdp close --all
```
